scripts.package:mac:arm64: pnpm build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.mjs --mac dir --arm64 --publish never
scripts.package:mac:x64: pnpm build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.mjs --mac dir --x64 --publish never
